title: Introducing the Blaze AI CFO
summary: Money without borders. Send, spend, and save across borders with Blaze, built for nomads, expats, and global businesses.
body_markdown:
**TL;DR:** 🔥 We built an AI CFO for your business. It forecasts your cash, sends your invoices, pays your bills and contractors, and gets you paid — across 80+ currencies. Others advise. Blaze acts. Try it free for 7 days.


Three years ago we started Blaze to fix something that made no sense: moving money across borders was slow, expensive, and built for people who never leave home.


Along the way, we ended up building a lot of finance tooling for ourselves — to forecast our runway, send invoices, pay contractors, and actually see where our cash was. It started as an internal tool. Turns out it was the most useful thing we'd built.


So we turned it into a product. Meet your AI CFO.


---


## 🤖 Others advise. Blaze acts.


Every other finance tool tells you what happened. Your AI CFO does something about it. It pays the invoice, sends the reminder, flags the low balance — while you're doing literally anything else.


Not a chatbot that reports your spending. An agent that runs your finances.


---


## 📈 Your money, on autopilot


The three things that eat every founder's week — forecasting, paying, and getting paid — handled without you.


- **Forecasts your cash** — knows your runway before you do
- **Pays your bills and contractors** — vendors and clients, on your behalf, across 80+ currencies
- **Collects with payment links** — clients request and pay you in a tap


The work that used to happen at midnight now happens on its own.


---


## ⌨️ Give your AI agents a finance stack


Already building with AI? Blaze plugs straight in. One command connects your finances to Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor — or run it standalone.


Ask Blaze to pay a bill, send an invoice, or check your runway — in plain English, wherever you already work.


---


## ⚡ Why it works


Blaze runs on stablecoin rails, so money moves as fast as your agent can think — instant settlement, no banking delays, no 9-to-5. That's the same infrastructure powering payments across 80+ currencies for people who live and work globally. Now it's working for your business, too.


And it's a fraction of the cost of a finance hire. A full-time bookkeeper runs ~$3,000/mo, a fractional CFO ~$5,000/mo. Your AI CFO is always on, and doesn't take weekends.


---


## Try your AI CFO free for 7 days


See exactly where your cash stands and what to automate first. No pitch — just your numbers, working for you.


[Try Blaze free →](https://blaze.money/)


Three years in, we're just getting started.


— The Blaze Team
